sql:
with o as (
  select lo.id, lo.strategy, lo.market_ticker, lo.created_at, lo.limit_price,
         lo.created_at + interval '245 minutes' cx
  from live_orders lo
  where lo.side = 'no' and lo.action = 'buy' and lo.kalshi_order_id is not null
    and lo.strategy in ('mmsell10','mmsell10a','mmsell10b','Lmmsell10','Cmmsell10','Dmmsell10','Emmsell10','Fmmsell10')
    and lo.created_at >= '2026-07-26T00:00:00Z' and lo.created_at < '2026-10-01T00:00:00Z'
    and coalesce(lo.cancel_reason, lo.status) ilike '%timeout%'
    and not exists (select 1 from fills f where f.kalshi_order_id = lo.kalshi_order_id)
), s as (
  select market_ticker, max(case when side = 'no' then resolved_value else 100 - resolved_value end) settle_no
  from paper_trades where resolved_value is not null and strategy like '%mmsell%'
    and market_ticker in (select market_ticker from o) group by 1
)
select o.id, o.strategy, o.market_ticker, o.created_at::date d, o.limit_price, s.settle_no,
       (select min(t.captured_at) from mmsell_position_ticks t where t.market_ticker = o.market_ticker
          and t.captured_at > o.cx and t.no_bid is not null and t.no_bid < o.limit_price) clear_at,
       (select count(*) from mmsell_position_ticks t where t.market_ticker = o.market_ticker and t.captured_at > o.cx) nticks,
       (select max(t.captured_at) from mmsell_position_ticks t where t.market_ticker = o.market_ticker) last_tick,
       o.cx
from o left join s using (market_ticker) order by o.created_at
